versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the category-page-brief skill for e-commerce.
- Generates a comprehensive brief for category/collection/Product Listing Pages (PLP) including search intent, keywords, intro copy, merchandising logic, filters, internal links, SEO/technical notes, and supporting content.
- Outlines required and inferred inputs, with guidance to flag any uncertainties.
- Provides a standardized, checklist-driven output format to optimize both shopper experience and SEO.
- Includes best practices and anti-patterns from e-commerce SEO and merchandising.
